frames.board: B: origin at the first board corner, x along the board rows (to the image LEFT for a face-on upright camera, R_BC0 = diag(-1, 1, -1)), y down (gravity +y, vertical board), z = board normal toward the camera; metres
frames.camera: cam0: x right, y down, z optical axis; pitch = about x, yaw = about y, roll = about z
frames.quat: R_BC (camera -> board) as [w, x, y, z]; p_C = camera centre in B
frames.imu: gyro / accel in IMU axes: v_cam = R_CI v_imu, R_CI = T_CtoI[:3,:3]^T; *_cam fields are already rotated
frames.outline: 4 outer corners TL TR BR BL as seen by a face-on upright camera, then midpoints of TL-TR, TR-BR, BR-BL, BL-TL

segments.name: rest
segments.label: Hold still
segments.cue: Hold the camera still in front of the board, count 3.

segments.name: aimed_orbit_az
segments.label: 1  Left-right
segments.cue: Swing left and right around the board, 2 times (about 39 deg to each side, 8.3 s per left-right-left), turning past facing it by about 15 deg at each end so the board slides to the left or right edge of the picture. Vary the speed, never a steady pace: push through the middle and brake into each end. Turn round sharply at each end. Keep the whole board in the picture.

segments.name: aimed_orbit_el
segments.label: 2  Up-down
segments.cue: Move up and down, 2 times (about 26 deg above and below the board, 6.1 s per up-down-up), tipping the camera past the board by about 29 deg so it reaches the top or bottom edge of the picture. Vary the speed, never a steady pace: push through the middle and brake into each end. Keep the whole board in the picture.

segments.name: depth_roll
segments.label: 3  Back-forth + roll
segments.cue: Move in to 0.28 m and back out to 0.60 m, 3 times (5.0 s per in-out), rolling the camera like a steering wheel up to about 55 deg, one way coming in and the other going out (the roll a little ahead of the in-out). Vary the speed, never a steady pace: push through the middle and brake into each end. Hold the board off-centre (aim about 20 deg beside it when far, 5 deg when near) so the roll carries it into the picture corners: one side first, then the other. Keep the whole board in the picture.

segments.name: plane_circle
segments.label: 4  Loop + roll
segments.cue: Move the camera round a loop parallel to the board, about 37 cm across, 2.1 times (4.8 s per loop), turning it a little against the loop (about 14 deg up-down, 6 deg left-right) so the board slides round the picture border and into each corner. Roll the camera too, about 6 deg one way and then the other, once per loop. Vary the speed: speed up and slow down twice per loop. Keep the whole board in the picture.
